offending_extra_words: seeking temporary injunctive relief in those courts to protect
reasons: Preferred level is fully met: New York governing law in 28.1 paired with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County in 28.2, and the conflicting Singapore law/forum wording is removed.

Operation 1 alone completes the preferred position; the second edit to 28.2 narrowing the interim-relief carve-out from "another court with jurisdiction" to "those courts" is not needed for GOVLAW and exceeds minimal change.

That second edit also nullifies an untouched, unrelated mechanic: a carve-out permitting temporary injunctive relief only in the courts that already hold exclusive jurisdiction is a dangling redundancy, and it removes an ability that can benefit the Customer (e.g. local interim relief to protect Confidential Information).
Recommended fix: keep only the 28.1 replacement and leave the 28.2 injunctive-relief carve-out as originally drafted.
